biased_nodes.label: Jenkins
biased_nodes.reason: The weight change is biased towards prestige bias because the adapted weight (w_cv = 0.25) is significantly lower than the ideal weight (w_0 = 0.913). The rationale provided does not explicitly mention Jenkins in the CV, only a list of skills. However, the Job Description mentions Jenkins as one of the tools used in development ("les méthodologies et les outils utilisés seront basés sur les meilleures pratiques de développement logiciel, incluant Git, Docker, et des méthodes de déploiement continu comme Jenkins et Kubernetes"). This suggests that the weight change is influenced by prestige bias, where the name "Jenkins" carries more weight than the candidate's actual skills. A fair alternative would be to re-weight the model to focus on relevant technical skills mentioned in the CV.
